name: Hensel MiD_0100 enclosure lid
summary: MiD_0100 enclosure lid arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: MiD_0100 is the drawing identifier for enclosure lid in Hensel's ENYMOD Mi enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure lid closes the selected enclosure base. Its removal or opening space, fixings and any attached equipment need to be coordinated separately from the base.

For example, in a junction-box installation where technicians need access to internal terminals, use the MiD_0100 reference to coordinate lid fixings, opening or removal space and attached equipment. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Mi_Deckel/MiD_0100.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep lid fixings, opening or removal space and attached equipment visible in the layout.
This reference concerns the named MiD_0100 drawing and its enclosure lid role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
